metadata.title: Ricci-Yamabe solitons on the Lie group $\Sol \times \mathbb{R}^n$
metadata.abstract: In this article, we study Ricci-Yamabe solitons on the Lie group $\mathrm{Sol} \times \mathbb{R}^n$ equipped with a natural left-invariant Riemannian metric, explicitly determining the vector fields that characterize them. We then deduce that, in the case of a Ricci soliton, it is expanding, whereas in the case of a Yamabe soliton, it is shrinking. Finally, we show that if this Lie group is a gradient Ricci-Yamabe soliton, the vector field belongs to $\operatorname{Span}\{\partial_{t_1}, \dots, \partial_{t_n}\}$, and we explicitly provide the Perelman potential.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 在带自然左不变度量的 Sol×Rⁿ 上确定 Ricci–Yamabe 孤立子向量场，并给出 Ricci、Yamabe 特例的膨胀或收缩性质及梯度情形的势函数。
analysis.breakthrough: 提供可直接比较的混合孤立子模型。
analysis.limitations: 仅处理指定 Lie 群和自然度量，不能外推到所有左不变度量或一般孤立子。 本次依据官方公告摘要分析，尚未核查正文和完整证明；未见披露仅指当前已读摘要与作者评论。
analysis.priorityReason: 具体模型计算占主导，对本组一般流方程与奇点问题的直接适用性有限。
analysis.lowPriorityReason: 具体模型计算占主导，对本组一般流方程与奇点问题的直接适用性有限。 此为本组阅读顺序，不是论文质量结论。
